title: backfillUids
responsibility: Gives every active unit a stable uid in its registry file and in its commentable source files, changing nothing else.

inputs.name: backfillUids.options
inputs.description: The optional root passed to loadUnits and a write flag controlling whether changes are applied. The function defaults the whole options argument to {}, so omitted or false write reports planned changes only; only active stored units are reviewed.

outputs.name: backfillUids
outputs.description: The resolved BackfillReport counts active stored units and lists newly assigned uids, source paths needing uid annotations, registry-only unit ids, uid disagreements, and files written. If write is omitted or false, planned assignments and annotations are still listed, written is zero, and conflicting units are skipped.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The promise rejects with a propagated error if loadUnits fails, or if a source read, source write, or registry write fails while write is enabled. The workflow does not catch or transform these failures.
